_doc: Every SHIPPED case file, appended at ship time. The rotation gates read this. Schema per entry, run_date, case_file_no, bank_id, company, industry, capability, flavor (case_file | capability_file | reality_check | translation), angle, headline, evidence_strength, sources_lead (array), outcome_notes. Company never repeats. Industry must differ from the last 3 entries. Capability must differ from the last 3 entries. Flavor rhythm per prompts/routine_instructions.md.

entries.company: SalmonVision program and Alaska's salmon counting system (translation flavor, no single company)
entries.angle: Alaska still counts salmon by eye, the counting machine arriving north, Redoubt Lake told straight, the watch and count translation for operators
entries.headline: Alaska still counts its salmon by eye.
entries.outcome_notes: First live run, driven in-session as the manual test. Score 8.39 ship at round 3 threshold 8.0. Fact-check killed the intended payoff (c31) and the honest version shipped. 28 verified claims, honesty gate two rounds, pixel critics three rounds, flow critic ship 8.5.

entries.company: La Crosse County Public Safety Communications, Wisconsin
entries.angle: They rebuilt one line and left the other alone
entries.bottleneck: The 24/7 dispatch desk had become the county's default number for every routine municipal question, so dispatchers were putting routine callers on hold to answer 911
entries.rung_note: Honestly a WORKFLOW. Every step was drawn by a person before the phone rang. The vendor calls it an agent, and that gap is the curriculum payload.

numbers.contained: about 65 percent never reached a dispatcher, base = the 41,000 (c04)
numbers.annual_baseline: roughly 105,000 routine calls a year, per the county (c08)
numbers.pricing: priced on call volume, not per seat (c14)
numbers.staffing: four dispatchers per shift, before and after (c36, c37)

entries.honest_limit: No resolution, satisfaction, callback or complaint figure exists on any page fetched this run, including the vendor's own (c53). Containment is not resolution.
entries.timeline_status: PARTIAL. Several months of intensive training before implementation (c18) plus a 5 May 2025 go-live. No decision-to-contract date exists on any page fetched.
entries.counter_case: Ozaukee County bought the same product, went live around the clock in week one, and cut back to two hours a day (c44 to c48). Same product, same vendor, different boundary.
entries.alaska_landing: Point it where a wrong route costs ten minutes, never where it costs a house or a hand.
entries.notes: Public-safety vein: 911 funding is a public surcharge, so local press prints the contract value. This is why the cost hard gate cleared here when it failed on 23 other candidates.
